privacy.metaDescription: What Chilly Coffee keeps on your device, what it shares with people in the café, and how the YouTube player works.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Chilly Coffee is a 3D café in your browser for studying and working. This page explains what the site stores, where it sends it and what you can do about it. In short: no account, no ads, no tracking or analytics.

sections.title: Data that stays on your device
paragraphs: The following is kept in your browser's storage (localStorage, sessionStorage) on your own device and is never sent to a server:
items: Your to-dos, notes and Pomodoro timer
Your display name and chosen character
Settings: volume, lite mode, rain, day / night, camera mode
The YouTube playlist or video link you paste and where you're up to
A random ID for the current session (gone when you close the tab)
after: To delete everything, clear the site data for chilly-coffee.pages.dev in your browser's settings.

sections.title: Sitting in the café with others
paragraphs: So people can see each other in the café, the site sends the following to everyone in the same room through Supabase's realtime service:
items: Your display name, character, position and facing direction
The seat you are at, whether your laptop is open, and actions (waving, drinking…)
Your Pomodoro status (focus / break, today's count) and whether you're wearing headphones
after: This is only relayed to people who are online. It is not stored in a database and is gone when you leave. Other people can still read your messages, so please don't share personal information in chat.
Your to-dos, notes and music link are never sent anywhere.

sections.title: Your music via YouTube
paragraphs: The My music app on the laptop uses YouTube API Services (YouTube's official player). The player only loads after you paste a YouTube link, and it uses privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com).

Once the player loads, Google / YouTube may collect data and store cookies on your device under their own policies. Chilly Coffee does not access your YouTube account or watch history; it only reads the playback state (playing, paused, which track) to adjust the volume and resume next time.
By using My music you agree to YouTube's Terms of Service.

sections.title: Hosting
paragraphs: The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Like any web server, Cloudflare processes your IP address and technical browser information to deliver the page and protect against attacks.
Fonts, café music and 3D models are served with the site itself, not from Google Fonts or other third parties.

sections.title: Browser notifications
paragraphs: If you allow it, the Pomodoro timer sends a browser notification when time is up. Notifications are created on your device, and you can turn them off in your browser's settings at any time.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: When new features are added (for example sign-in), this page will be updated and the date at the top changed. For questions or to report a problem, open an issue on the project's GitHub.
